desc: Implement fast input parsing and build a frequency array up to \(M=\max A_i\).
Compute `count[d] = sum(freq[m] for m in multiples of d)` using a harmonic-series sieve.
Traverse divisors from \(M\) down to \(1\), and for every \(d\) with `count[d] >= K`, assign \(d\) to unassigned present multiples.
Store answers indexed by value and emit the answer corresponding to each original array element.
Ensure the implementation uses compact arrays and avoids per-element divisor enumeration, keeping time near \(O(M\log M)\).
